If $X \sim \textrm{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14165669/assets/f6da43d5d0276991429f04048f3ea4e7ec2b4d9727abc71f4d7879cefd71797b.svg)

Here, $X \sim \textrm{Geom}\left(\dfrac 37\right),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14165669/assets/bcba51c019bfe72f14e0fb7d6465abf3595b03c8e70598231934f5166393873b.svg)

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<5) & =P(X\in \{1,2,3,4\}) \\  & =P(X=1)+P(X=2)+P(X=3)+P(X=4) \\  & =f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4) \\  & ={(\frac{4}{7})}^{0}(\frac{3}{7})+{(\frac{4}{7})}^{1}(\frac{3}{7})+{(\frac{4}{7})}^{2}(\frac{3}{7})+{(\frac{4}{7})}^{3}(\frac{3}{7}) \\  & ≈0.893\end{aligned}
$$

to  $3$ decimal places.
